name: SypherPK Clipping
brief: Fortnite / UEFN (Fortnite Creative) stream from November 15 where SypherPK (Sypher), Replays and Maddynf play TOGETHER. Clips must feature all three playing together as the primary focus: banter between them, hype reactions, funny moments, big plays. Never portray Sypher, Replays, Maddynf, Fortnite, Epic Games or UEFN negatively; no hate-farming or negative false narratives.
